Recap and ask (short): Novacorp's acceptance window has moved because their eval harness stalled. They are prepared to run an accelerated 48-hour evaluation that includes new prompts, but Procurement will only finalize if we commit to a firm start/end window and (if requested) short-term reserved capacity. The customer suggested Thu 07/24 09:00 EDT -> Sat 07/26 09:00 EDT.

What we propose (recommended):
- Approve a 48-hour priority slot (one dedicated worker) for Novacorp and allow an operational buffer of +72 hours for remediation (this is an exception to normal backfill policy).
- Approve a one-time credit to offset token overage if the accelerated run exceeds forecast by >20%.
- Authorize Ben to sign off on the slot/credit terms and Jordan to publish the updated MAP and canary gating.

Why we need this escalation: if we decline the reserved slot or fail to give fixed dates, Procurement will delay the PO which moves the contract close out by an indeterminate amount. This looks like a close-date diversion rather than a permanent scope change — we can preserve contract value by a short exception.

Related artifacts attached: exec_exception_request.docx (proposal for credit + buffer language), novacorp_map_v2.xlsx. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3521

If you approve, can you reply-all with a one-line approval (slot + credit exception) so I can pass that to Patricia and Procurement and lock the dates?

Thanks,
